physical_errors.scope:
Saved-state Eulerian Kepler reference; no fit, RHS, or evolution.

Run on lageunha. q32 refines interface-crossing cells and the union of
q16 maximum-error cells. Scientific judgments belong to the Astra review.
physical_errors.covariance_note: R metric derives raw S/C/Pi and includes cancellation; factor_R uses saved LL^T minus reference R. mass_relative_reference normalizes by q16 exact mass; pressure_relative_P0 normalizes by IC P0.
physical_errors.numerical_potential_state: absent: exact-field Psi is a reference integral, not numerical evolved Psi
physical_errors.limits: No material-centroid orbit scoring; fixed numerical mass is not substituted into reference. RMS uses numerical masses. q32 outside selected mask is a copy of q16, not independent integration. No order, long-time, closure-ranking or conservation verdict.

physical_error_components.scope:
Velocity components and origin angular momentum from cached raw integrals.

No geometry rebuild, quadrature, fit, RHS, or evolution. Missing q32 coverage
at a new maximum is recorded explicitly for the bundled reference review.
physical_error_components.velocity_basis: Common to numerical/reference within each endpoint: radial from current generator position about Kepler origin; azimuthal=(-er_y,er_x). Not material-centroid orbit scoring.
physical_error_components.limits: q32 data exist only on original selected mask. New maxima outside it remain unrefined. Region sums compare different fields on same current cells, not a closed-system conservation test. No long-time or order verdict.
